messages:
morgan: Heads-up — canary in eu-west after the runtime unpin showed a sharp regression for long-sequence workloads. 95p token latency ~2x and KV-cache miss rate spiked. Thinking we should rollback the unpin for runtime v3.2.1 in eu-west.

deploybot: Deploybot: unpin request detected for runtime v3.2.1 in eu-west; automatic canary hold engaged. See /deploy/queue for details.

sanjay: What do the logs show? OOMs, timeouts, or kernel stalls?

morgan: Logs look like repeated cache fallback + higher tail latencies. snippet from one of the canary hosts:
```
[2026-03-21T11:03:12Z] kv_cache: miss_rate=0.43, kernel_selector: selected=alt-kernel, latency_p95=512ms
[2026-03-21T11:03:13Z] infer: rpc_err=DeadlineExceeded, retries=3
[2026-03-21T11:03:14Z] scheduler: batch_size=1 forced, reason=cache_miss
```

alexa: I'm seeing the same pattern in staging after we flipped the kernel selection heuristic last week — compaction path seems to push more fetches to fallback, increasing per-token work.

jit: If it's KV fallback thrashing, we should rollback regionally. Suggest: rollback eu-west to runtime v3.1.9, keep other regions on v3.2.1 for now, and re-run canary at smaller qps.

morgan: +1. Action plan: 1) Rollback eu-west runtime to v3.1.9 now. 2) Temporarily pin the llama3q model-family to avoid routing to quant variants during investigation. 3) Run narrow canary on 4 hosts with traffic replay. 4) Prepare release note entry.

deploybot: Deploybot: rollback initiated — setting runtime to v3.1.9 on 12 nodes in eu-west. ETA ~4m. Rolling back only runtime config; model catalog unchanged.

ops-oncall: I'll hook up the SLO guard: if error_rate > 1% or p95 latency > 400ms for 10m post-rollback, escalate and keep rollback. I'll also bookmark the trace IDs morgan pasted.

sanjay: For release notes: short line — "runtime unpin to v3.2.1 caused long-sequence latency regression in eu-west; rolled back to v3.1.9. Root cause under investigation (kernel selector + KV fallback)." Anyone want different wording?

morgan: fine by me. Also propose we add a sticky pin for runtime on the llama3q model-family (internal pinlist) until the kernel patch lands and we have perf numbers. I'll open the RFC/issue.

alexa: I'll open the patch PR and add a perf test that replays longseq traces. ping me if you want to pair. :thumbsup:

morgan: Thanks — will follow up in the postmortem channel once we have root cause. Keeping this thread for live coord.

deploybot: Deploybot: rollback succeeded on all targeted nodes. Canary hold remains until manual resume.

ops-oncall: Monitoring shows p95 back to baseline after rollback. I'll keep the dashboard pinned for 2 hours.

morgan: Closing live coord — next steps: PR + perf test, pinlist update, postmortem draft. Thanks everyone.
